lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the bend where the left tab meets the saddle wall, about 77 deg (included angle about 103 deg) with an inner radius of about 3 mm, clearly tighter than the U roll. I checked 13 perpendicular sections: the vertex of a quadratic fit to the outer skin sits 0.11-0.15 mm from the line, which lies on the convex skin (tab top plus the U's inner face). Sections at 25/50/75% show the line dot on the outer apex at every station. The line is 39.1 mm long against a part extent of about 40.5 mm along it, running edge to edge in the face-on and oblique close-ups. It is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is the matching bend where the right tab meets the saddle wall, about 77 deg with an inner radius of about 3 mm. Across 13 sections the line is 0.11-0.16 mm from the fitted outer-skin vertex. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex. The line is 39.2 mm long against a part extent of about 40.4 mm, so it covers the full width, and it is parallel to the fold.
